knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Staff leaving because of pay and rostering is an external pressure on the business, and it has causes the owner can influence. The other options are internal strengths or a fixed service area.
A strength becomes usable when a measure shows it. Adjectives and placement in another box do not add evidence.
A weakness matched with a threat points to a protective action. A strength matched with an opportunity points to a growth action.

practicalCriteria: SWOT analysis has each item either evidenced or labelled as an assumption.
The top three items in each box are ranked.
At least one strength or weakness is paired with an opportunity or threat, producing an action with an owner and a review date.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark (all 3 of 3 correct for this lesson). A quiz pass is not verified practical competence. The SWOT analysis is assessed separately by an assessor against the practical criteria.
evidenceRequired: Dated SWOT analysis reviewed by an assessor
Action log entry with owner and review date
stopWorkCriteria: Stop acting on an opportunity that has no recorded local test.
